variables.variableName: Fluorescence mean in lateral root(s) (filter F448)
variables.methodDescription: A RootCam fluorescence image is acquired using a user-selected FluorCam protocol and emission filter. The raw TAR contains the acquisition protocol, including excitation-channel percentages, filter selection, shutter time and sensitivity. FC_analysis.py extracts the archived .dumm image, horizontally flips it, and applies filter- and FC-unit-specific geometric alignment to the ROI masks generated from the corresponding backlit image. Mean or summed pixel intensity is then calculated within each ROI. ROI pixel counts are represented separately as channel-independent mask variables rather than duplicated by filter.
variables.methodReference: FC_analysis.py; Hades-Camera_tech_spec.pdf; FluorCam acquisition protocol in raw TAR; PSI FluorCam light-intensity calibration SN-FC800-425
variables.filterNotes: Common assay mappings used at NPEC: mCherry -> F635; coumarin-related fluorescence -> F483; mTurquoise2 -> F513; GFP -> F513/F520; YFP emission near 596 nm is captured with the HADES F593 filter.

acquisition.lightProfile: Per-acquisition FluorCam protocol from the raw acquisition TAR. The protocol may activate one or multiple excitation channels at user-defined percentages (Act1, Act2, Super, FAR, UV, RBLUE, BLUE, GREEN, AMBER, RED) and also records settings such as Filter, ShutterTime, and Sensitivity.

variables.notes: Canonical fluorescence IDs are emission-filter driven. Excitation is not a finite pattern axis because the FluorCam protocol can combine multiple light channels at arbitrary controller percentages; the full excitation recipe is retained as per-acquisition metadata in the raw protocol/TAR. Controller percentages must not be interpreted as directly comparable physical irradiance without the relevant instrument calibration.

variables.variableName: Emission spectrum mean in peri-root region (349.9nm-899.1nm)
variables.methodDescription: VNIR2 hyperspectral cubes are acquired under 365 nm UV excitation in reflection geometry and corrected using matched dark-reference measurements. Invalid pixels are repaired, spectra are Savitzky-Golay smoothed, and spatial median filtering is applied before horizontal flipping and padding. RootCam masks are transferred to the cube using two-stage registration: a shoot-derived transform against a leaf reference near 670 nm, followed by root refinement against a root-enhanced reference near 410 nm. Final root and exclusive peri-root ROIs are used to export wavelength-resolved mean, sum and standard-deviation spectra.

variables.variableName: Seed side

Seed Side (0/1) distinguishes the two orthogonal views, while Length, SSE, AxesAngle, Width, Surface and PixelCount are emitted directly in the raw table. The vendor does not disclose the exact segmentation, ellipse-fit or calibration algorithms. Manuscript-level quantities such as L/S ratio, roundness, selection thresholds, or averages across the two sides are downstream derived values and are intentionally not separate canonical source variables in this registry.
variables.methodReference: Boxeed raw Seeding table; Labdeers Boxeed 2.1 public documentation
variables.notes: Acquisition-side indicator, not a biological plant trait.
